notes: «جماعة مشايخي منهم» : the two named men are members of that group; the group phrase is not written as a separate link
«جَمِيعاً» makes the three of the third level co-transmitters that meet at الحسن بن علي بن فضال
«عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ (ع) أَنَّهُ قَالَ» : the Imam after «عن» stays narrator (owner ruling 2)
